information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) Please take the time to read the FAQ tab, even if you have previously competed. To ensure this is a COVID-safe environment, things will be done differently and there will be additional conditions in place. This is a twin competition alongside Adelaide Twin Sunday 2021. **You will be permitted to compete at ONLY ONE of the two competitions**. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each day has a different set of events. If you feel sick, stay at home. If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will not be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)
